article.title: City orders evacuation near dam
article.description: Riverbend officials ordered evacuations after cracks were found at North Dam.
article.text: Riverbend officials ordered evacuations for three neighborhoods after engineers found cracks at North Dam. Mayor Elena Cruz said the spillway would stay closed until Monday. The water authority said rainfall could raise reservoir levels by 30 centimeters overnight.

article.title: Talks resume over border ceasefire
article.description: Mediators said delegations agreed to meet again in Geneva.
article.text: Mediators said delegations from Lydora and Marek agreed to meet again in Geneva. The Marek foreign ministry alleged Lydora had moved artillery near the Kars crossing, a claim Lydora denied. UN envoy Priya Nair said monitors recorded no shelling after 06:00 local time.
